_comment: HAND-COMPUTED expectations for probes/widgets/textfx/Main.as. Never regenerate these by running the probe.

_derivation.geometry: Window 460x520; root column, padding 20, gap 12, alignItems flex-start, white. Children in order: sh (size [120,60]) then gr (size [160,40]). So sh = 20,20,120,60 and gr = 20,20+60+12=92,160,40. ref/wr/el/ta follow with auto heights, so their rects are reported by the probe but not pinned here (a pinned auto height would pin a font metric).
points: (10,10) is inside the root's 20px padding -> the root's white.
(80,22) is inside sh, 2px below its top edge and 60px in from its left edge -> the box's own white face (the shadow is offset DOWN by 8, so nothing is painted above the box).
(100,70) is inside sh, away from the 8px corner radius (which only cuts x>132 / y>72) -> white again.
_derivation.not_pinned: The shadow itself (a grey pixel 4px BELOW the box at (80,84), plus the absence of any bleed above it), the gradient ramp (left/mid/right strictly increasing), the wrapped height against an unwrapped reference of the same string, the ellipsised string and its width, and the text area's Return-inserts-not-commits behaviour are all asserted inside Main.as and reported through <OUT>.done -- their exact values depend on a font metric or a filter kernel, so pinning a constant here would be copying the program's output instead of stating a contract.
